# PPTX spec

```jsonc
{
  "theme": { "preset": "clean-light | clean-dark | warm", "accent": "#2F6FD0" },
  "template": { "path": "decks/brand.pptx", "mode": "reuse | style" },
  "meta": { "title": "…", "author": "…" },
  "slides": [ … ]
}
```

## Layouts

| layout | fields |
| --- | --- |
| title | `title`, `subtitle`, `notes` |
| section | `title`, `notes` |
| bullets | `title`, `bullets[]`, `notes` |
| two-column | `title`, `left`, `right` — each `{bullets}`, `{text}`, or `{image}` |
| image | `image`, `caption`, `alt`, `title` |
| chart | `title`, `chart {type, categories[], series[{name, values[]}]}` |
| table | `title`, `columns[]`, `rows[][]` |
| kpis | `title`, `items[{label, value, delta}]` |
| quote | `quote`, `attribution` |
| closing | `title`, `subtitle` |

Chart types: `bar`, `column`, `line`, `pie`, `scatter`.

A bullet is a string or `{text, level}`. `level` is 0 or 1; the first bullet
cannot be a sub-bullet.

## Limits

| what | limit |
| --- | --- |
| slides in a deck | 60 |
| title characters | 60 |
| bullets a slide | 6 |
| characters a bullet | 90 |
| bullet levels | 2 |
| table columns | 8 |
| table rows including the header | 12 |
| KPI items | 2 to 4 |
| chart series | 6 |
| chart categories | 24 |
| pie slices | 12 |
| notes characters | 2000 |

Every series must have exactly one value per category. Images must be PNG,
JPEG, or GIF and inside the workspace.

## Template reuse

`template: {"path": "decks/brand.pptx", "mode": "reuse"}` copies the source
deck's theme, masters, and layouts, and fills new slides into them. `"style"`
lifts its colours and fonts into our layouts instead. The file *is* their theme
either way — this is not a restyle of their slides.
